title: LM Router 1.0.0
release_notes:
• Your own Kiri Router gateway, fetched live and running on-device. No setup, no API key
• The router's `auto` model: it rotates across healthy free models for you
• Live model catalog with per-model rate limits and endpoint types
• Chat with streaming replies, visible reasoning, and expandable tool calls
• Web search plus your own MCP servers (search, fetch and anything else you add)
• Share your gateway on a public URL, with an optional API key
• Conversation history, markdown export, and a live gateway console
